messages.subject: Fwd: Debug in statet
messages.body_plain:
Hi all,

How may I debug in StatET? I set up breakpoint in my code, but it won't
break at the line. Am I missing steps?
Basically, when I added breakpoint, it appears as blue dot with a half
right arrow (>) overlaid. And it did not stop at the breakpoint when
running through the entire file.

thanks,

Wei

messages.subject: Re: Fwd: Debug in statet
messages.body_plain:
Wei,

The answer is in the documentation.
Help > Help Contents > StatET User Guide > Visual Debugger

I also found the following post helpful.
http://lists.r-forge.r-project.org/pipermail/statet-user/2011-November/001098.html

Regards,
Rob
